test_title: PYST 16: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 12 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the maximum percentage of reservation allowed for Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) under the 103rd Amendment Act, 2019?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**10%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **103rd Amendment Act, 2019** introduced a provision for **reservation of 10%** for the **Economically Weaker Sections (EWS)** of the general category in government jobs and educational institutions.
 
• This amendment added **Clause (6)** to **Article 15** and **Article 16** of the Indian Constitution to enable this provision.
 
• The reservation is aimed at providing social and economic justice to individuals who belong to the **general category** but face financial hardships.
 
• The criteria for EWS reservation include individuals whose family income is below **₹8 lakh per annum**, among other asset-related conditions.
 
• This is the first reservation provision in India based solely on **economic criteria**, rather than caste, tribe, or backward class categories.
 
• The cap of **10%** was decided to ensure that the overall reservation in India does not exceed the **50% ceiling** imposed by the Supreme Court in the **Indra Sawhney judgment (1992).**
 
• The amendment is widely regarded as a significant step toward addressing the needs of economically disadvantaged sections of society while balancing constitutional provisions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Article 15(6)**__

 __
 
• Article 15(6) allows the state to make special provisions for the **advancement of Economically Weaker Sections (EWS)** in matters of education.
 
• This includes reservation in **educational institutions**, both aided and unaided, except for minority institutions.
 
 
 
• **Article 16(6)**__
 __
 
• Article 16(6) empowers the state to provide reservation to the **Economically Weaker Sections** in matters of **employment**.
 
• This ensures equal opportunity in public employment for individuals from economically weaker backgrounds.
 
 
 
• **Indra Sawhney Judgment**__
 
 
• The **Indra Sawhney case (1992)** established the **50% ceiling** for reservations in India to maintain the principle of equality.
 
• It also clarified the concept of **social and educational backwardness** as a basis for reservation.
